svg.title: A slow session: three places to check
svg.desc: A slow session has three places to check: how long the network path is (round-trip time), how full it is (bandwidth, packet loss, jitter), and how busy the session host is (CPU, memory, input delay). Connection Information on the client, connection network data and connection graphics data in Log Analytics, and AVD Insights show where to look. QoS and the throttle rate apply only to the RDP Shortpath for managed networks path.
